title: Harry Potter By Balenciaga | Step by Step Tutorial
summary: A step-by-step tutorial on making a Harry Potter by Balenciaga style AI video, using tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney and Eleven Labs for script, images and voices.
why: HN cites it as a process example of how such AI-generated videos are made, including on a phone.

quote.text: Some time after it came a "making of" video which outlined how they used ChatGPT to prompt Midjourney to create the images
